# Eyepl 0.3.1 — clearer host-goal guidance

This patch completes the host-supplied goal experience introduced in 0.3.0.

## Documentation and tooling

- Move goal selection from the language-declarations discussion to the command-line chapter, where it belongs.
- Document selecting one or several goals with repeated `--goal` options.
- Give the GitHub Release and npm-publishing workflows clear names in the Actions view.

## Playground and examples

- Let the playground prefill and run every declared example goal.
- Repair the DPLL SAT example so its model and derived results are displayed reliably.

## Validation

The complete project suite passes: 1,187 tests.
